17754.overview: A Finnish social networking service aimed at teenagers. The website is owned and operated by Sulake Corporation. The service began in 2000 and has expanded to include 11 online communities (or "hotels"), with users in over 150 countries.In August 2012, the site opened to users from Turkey. As of August 2011, over 230 million avatars have been registered. There are an average 10 million unique visitors monthly.

118363.overview: Heroes of Gaia , known in the separate European version as Castle of Heroes, is a massively multiplayer online fantasy browser-based strategy game developed by the Chinese developer Snail Games and published in the United States by its U.S. publishing division, Snail Games USA. Published in the Europe by gPotato Europe, the online game portal of Gala Networks Europe.

118389.overview:
Hunted Forever is a flash-based platform game released in 2008.It was single–handedly created by Evan Miller, who was a college student at the time he developed the game.[citation needed] Actual development of the game itself was accomplished in six weeks. Miller first published the game on the social gaming website king.com in October 2008. Since then, it has been spread to many other online gaming websites.

The game made the top eighth spot in Time Magazine's "Top 10 Video Games of 2008" list. The game was praised for its style and innovation. As of late 2008, the game has been played some 2 million times.

122721.overview:
Enter the dungeons of Hack Slash Crawl to find your fortune. Be prepared for anything, because no two dungeons are alike.

Hack Slash Crawl is an introduction to Roguelikes. Characterized by permanent deaths and randomly generated dungeons, Hack Slash Crawl puts a slight spin on the genre by including titles that are unlockable after playthroughs that reach certain criteria, further cementing the game as an addicting experience.

135707.overview:
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Motorbike Escape is a free online video game released by Warner Bros. in November 2010, before the release of Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1.
In the game you play as Harry Potter, while he is flying with Hagrid to The Burrow on Sirius Black's motorbike, and cast spells against the Death Eaters.
The player can use the Essence of Dittany to gain an extra life and the Dragon Fire to fly faster. They may also target opponents with the Disarming Charm and successful use of it will eliminate that Death Eater from the battle, though if the Death Eater has already cast a spell, it must still be dodged. Successful hits can score anywhere from 50 to 500 points.

141991.overview:
Happy Wheels is a ragdoll-physics-adventure based Flash game created by Jim Bonacci and launched in June of 2010. Players control a selection of various, unique characters with their goal being to get to the finish line, activate a trigger that triggers victory, or collect a required amount of tokens while avoiding being splattered across the level by many hazards and obstacles.

     Users may create and share their own custom scenarios using the expansive level editor, play some of the over 9 million already-existing user-made levels, or take a look at some of the featured levels - the best levels in the game. The game is most notable for its dark sense of humor and its large amounts of blood and gore. 

     The full version allows you to go to the up-to-date version, while the demo stays on v1.10 (however, another version of the demo stays on v1.52), with limited features.

150733.overview: With 16 levels of gameplay, 32 weapons, 3 powerups and an unlimited supply of white knuckle action, Heli Attack 3 is the deserving sequel to the hugely successful Heli Attack 2. Also featuring a complete training mission, plenty of sound effects and an original music score, Heli Attack 3 is sure to be a fan favourite.

167854.overview:
Hilly.io is a racing io game with power-ups and simple animation.
Get in the most exciting and addictive ball racer experience by Clown Games! 
Jump over the hills and use space bar or left click of your mouse to land smoothly!
Jump higher, move faster and complete the race as a winner ball!
Start the race against others! Can you be the first player to jump over the hills?

201245.overview:
Hole.io is a 2018 arcade physics puzzle game with battle royale mechanics created by French studio Voodoo for Android and iOS. Players control a black hole moving around an urban area. By consuming various objects, holes will increase in size, allowing players to consume larger objects as well as smaller players.

Web Browser version:
https://www.minijuegos.com/juego/hole-io

215600.overview: Henry has been captured by the government, but they've offered him a deal. If Henry can help them take down the Toppat Clan, an international group of theives, his charges will be dropped. Henry will have to find a way into their airship and figure out a way to deal with the Toppats.

423326.overview:
Haluz 2 is an adventure Flash game released in 2007.

In this game, the player must guide a hero who is on his rescue mission and travel with him through air, land and underground caves to find a kidnapped girl and bring her back to safety.

423344.overview: A gore version of Who Wants to be a Millionaire. Put your hand at risk to get a million dollars. You must be fast if you want to grab the money take into account the sequence of the gallows!

438415.overview: In Helicopter Game the player controls a helicopter through a series of levels, dodging walls and edges with the goal being to make it as far as possible without any collision. The only control is the mouse using left-click to hover up and releasing it to hover down.

438416.overview: The first in the Hoshi Saga series, this game sets the basic premise for all that follow it: it presents players with a simple challenge -- through numerous disparate and unrelated Flash minigames, in each of them the player's goal is to use the mouse to reveal a 5-pointed star which is hidden there somewhere. Across 36 different black-and-white levels, the basic rules of interaction are different in nearly every screen -- sometimes the star is "out of scope", which needs to be rotated or adjusted; sometimes it is obscured by other objects also on the screen. In some screens the player needs to "draw" the star themself, in positive or negative space. Each level is completed upon the revelation of its star, and upon the completion of every 5 levels, a 6th bonus one becomes available.

438419.overview: Hex Empire is a turn-based strategy game played on a randomly generated hex-based map. The player takes command of the military forces of one of four kingdoms, with the goal of conquering the whole map. Each army's strength is measured by the sum of its manpower (added at the start of every turn in cities, its pool increases the more cities, ports and land you have) and morale (up to manpower level, increases as you conquer map and defeat enemies, drops when you're losing). Seas can be crossed when an army enters a port. You must move quickly in order to capture cities before your enemies do so and overwhelm you by sheer numbers. Losing the capital equals defeat.

438420.overview:
Hedgehog Launch is in the style Turkey Fling where player has only one goal, to launch Minovia the Hedgehog into space using a sling shot and a set of rockets. The player starts out with $50.00 and can grab extra money by steering Minovia into coins scattered through the screen, ranging from $0.25 to $5.00 and get an extra launch by landing on platforms that range from $1.00 to $10.00.

The player uses this money to upgrade the slingshot, more fuels for the rockets, an emergency rocket that will give the player an extra boost of speed, a radar that shows the player the location of the platforms and a parachute that will slow the player down. After each run, the money is added up and bonus are added depending on how high the hedgehog traveled and how long it stayed in the air.

The controls are simplistic, using the mouse button to click onto the hedgehog and pulling down and releasing to launch the hedgehog into the air, using the left and right keyboard buttons to steer, the up button to fire the emergency rocket and the down button to deploy the parachute. There is no health system or time limit and the game is over once the hedgehog reaches space.

438421.overview: Hexagon is an arcade action video game developed by Terry Cavanagh, which was created for a twelve-hour game jam in early 2012.

438422.overview:
In How to Raise a Dragon, players guide a dragon through its life phases, shaping its abilities and behavior.

The game begins with the dragon hatching from it's egg. As a hatchling, it can eat several types of food, determining the coloring of it's skin. But at the end of the stage, the little hatchling is trapped by a wizard.

As a young adult, the dragon is trapped in the wizard's castle, trying to find a way out. During this phase, the dragon can develop certain breathe abilities (fire, healing, plant growth, or even none), once again by eating certain items.

Reaching adulthood, the dragon roams the countryside, interacting with humans and seeking a lair, this phase determining the dragons behavior.

In the last stage, a hero appears, whose destiny is linked with the dragon. The hero can choose to befriend, pay tribute, or slay the dragon, all of these actions concluding in one of five possible endings.

438423.overview: HomeRun is a running flash game.

438425.overview:
Hobo Brawl, also known as Hobo, is a fighting flash game that was developed by SeethingSwarm and released on October 27, 2008.

In Hobo Brawl, the player controls a homeless man who is sleeping in the city dump and is woken up by a police officer whacking him with his baton and telling him to leave. Once the player gains control, they have the option to fight back using punches, kicks and a few other moves. As the player leaves the dump, they will encounter some dump workers and once they have defeated them, they can move onto the streets and will fight more civilians and the game goes on as the player continues through the city, fighting lots of different types of people in different areas who get progressively more difficult.

As the player progresses through the game, they will reach checkpoints and be informed of a password they can use to return to that checkpoint after they return to the game at a later date.  Progression will also unlock various fighting combos that make the player more effective at fighting.

438426.overview:
Hands of War is an Rpg game made by Axis Games (Djugan), and published by Bubblebox and Armor Games.

The player can choose a class, which can be a Warrior, Wizard, or Ranger. There is two warring factions, the Alliance and the Shadow Runners. Other warring factions are the Merchant's Guild vs. Mercenaries, and the Trackers vs. Magicians vs. Blademasters. The player has to choose a side between these warring factions.

The player has to choose a side and then complete quests given by members of that side, found in camps. After completing enough quests in an area (or by having a high-enough standing with that faction), they then visit the area's city to get a quest for a Heartstone piece. Along the game, the player can upgrade their character and obtain items they will wear to become stronger. The main objective is to collect all four pieces of the Heartstone, a Jewel with legendary strength, to stop the war.

438427.overview:
A tribute to Real-Time Strategy greats such as Age of Empire and Starcraft you will harvest trees, hunt animals, explore, build and conquer in your quest to seek vengeance on Lord Vilereck for taking control of the crown.

Prepare to save princesses, train wizards and even build mighty fortresses to recruit your own legion of knights and lead your massive armies to victory, or die trying…

438431.overview:
What was that? You awaken to find your once quiet house is full of noisy party guests! Can't a ghost haunt in peace?

Possess items around the house and scare everyone out! The more you scare, the more powerful you become. Don't frighten them too much though, they might freak out and do something stupid...

447927.overview: Hide the Fart is a free puzzle game. You've got some major gas, and nowhere to let it out. You and wasabi just don't mix. Can you be discreet with your stinkers?

450796.overview:
Hero Wars is an online action role-playing game (RPG) that offers an epic fantasy adventure. In this game, you can:

Collect and upgrade dozens of heroes to build a powerful team.
Engage in PvP arena battles against other players.
Fight against the Archdemon and his evil army in various campaigns.
Join guilds and participate in large-scale guild wars.
Summon mighty Titans to strengthen your team.
The game features colorful fantasy action-packed RPG battles and numerous campaigns to satisfy your thirst for adventure.

454020.overview:
Our beloved Hobo is back!
Last time we left him happily in prison and now he's ready for another disgusting brawl.
Prisoners, security guards or the government, he doesnt care! He'll fight them all!

NOTICE: Anyone is free to make videos of my games. Sharing video game experiences with others is really nice. It gives me some exposure while the people who make the videos get something back in return. I fully support the monetisation of any video you make containing footage from my games. As long as you don’t claim to be the creator of my games, it’s all good! Throwing my name, SeethingSwarm, as the creator into the description or into the video itself is also always appreciated.

Controls
A to punch and pick up objects
S for kicks and stuff
Arrow keys to move

482465.overview: An underground adventure for the three sheep from Home Sheep Home 2. Switch between the small, medium and heavy sheep to solve physical obstacles in tunnels and bring all three safely to the exit.

482468.overview: A puzzle platformer starring three sheep from Shaun the Sheep. Small Timmy, agile Shaun and heavy Shirley must combine their abilities to cross obstacles and bring everyone to the exit.

482486.overview: A puzzle platformer following Shaun, Timmy and Shirley through London. Each sheep has a different size and ability, requiring character switching and teamwork to overcome the obstacles.

482491.overview: A space adventure for Shaun, Timmy and Shirley from Home Sheep Home 2. Use their different sizes and abilities to solve logical and physical obstacles and get all three sheep to the exit.
